resources.string: XApps for HyperOS: XGoogle, XSecurity and XNotify in one module. Turn each part on or off in the app.
Parts that are on work in the apps ticked in LSPosed.
Enable XApps in LSPosed, then open this screen again.
Google Assistant, Gemini, Circle to Search, Lens, Wallet and Google services on HyperOS

Phone notifications on the Xiaomi tablet and Xiaomi\'s reply box for every app
Turning a part on or off takes effect after a reboot.

Once hidden, open XApps from its module settings in LSPosed.
